project_summary.request: Investigate and plan fixes for reports that the UI is laggy, slow, and updates late. Planning only; do not implement fixes.
evidence: React/TypeScript UI, package scripts, and test configuration inspected.
No runtime profiling trace, measured baseline, or exact user reproduction was available.

likely_causes.cause: StreamingMarkdown.tsx splits/scans the complete accumulated response to build chunks on renders; live answer events publish accumulated text. Work may grow with answer length and delta frequency.
likely_causes.confidence: Strong code-path candidate, unmeasured in user scenario.

likely_causes.cause: MarkdownRenderer.tsx uses ReactMarkdown, remarkGfm, and rehypeHighlight automatic language detection; parsing/highlighting may delay visible updates.
likely_causes.confidence: Potentially expensive operation; actual cost unmeasured.

likely_causes.cause: ChatBox.tsx workflow/message mapping repeatedly scans and filters messages; may amplify frequent state updates.
Large activity feeds/history may add cost: ToolActivityFeed maps all activities and may JSON.stringify tool args; useChatHistory derives recent chats and saves chats on changes.

assumptions: Streaming assistant responses may be the triggering flow; confirm, and separately test general navigation/input lag.
Preserve complete answers, markdown/GFM/code rendering, activity ordering, persistence, cancellation, and chat/window behavior unless an approved measured tradeoff is necessary.
package.json provides npm test (vitest run) and npm run build (tsc then vite build).
unresolved_questions: Which action reproduces lag; does input freeze or only the rendered answer?
What device/build mode, answer size, conversation length, and activity count reproduce it?
What visible-update latency/frame target and highlighting tradeoffs are acceptable?

direct: toolActivity.ts producer -> useToolActivity.ts store/subscribers -> ChatBox.tsx -> AssistantMessage.tsx -> StreamingMarkdown.tsx/MarkdownRenderer.tsx is the live answer path. Event cadence/payload changes affect all consumers.
Markdown changes affect streamed and settled historical assistant messages.
ChatBox mapping changes affect workflow-to-message association, retries/edits, and workflow panels.
conditional: ToolActivityFeed.tsx/useToolActivity.ts scaling, useChatHistory.ts/chat-storage.ts persistence and derivation need changes only if profiling finds material cost. Existing row memoization and bounded activity-id scope are mitigations.
vitest.config.ts uses node environment and src/**/*.test.ts; it does not establish browser frame latency.
follow_up: Check event ordering, final flush, abort/reset/chat-switch behavior, two Tauri windows, accessibility/scroll, memory, and settled markdown after changes.
Mapper findings are source analysis, not runtime measurements; optimize only measured paths.

steps.title: Reproduce and baseline
steps.goal: Establish the affected flow and measurable baseline before changing code.
inputs_and_context: Likely flows: streaming response, long-chat navigation/scroll, active tool feed, general navigation; none confirmed.
Separate UI render delay from model/network wait and compare production with development.
actions: Record exact interaction, environment, response/message/activity sizes and whether input or display is delayed.
Repeat the scenario in production build; capture WebView/browser performance trace, React Profiler commits, long tasks, event-to-visible-update timing, and CPU/memory if available.
Compare short/long responses and delta rates; save sanitized reproduction, trace references, and metrics in existing performance docs or a discovered location (e.g. docs/performance/ui-baseline.md).

files_to_create.path: Discover existing docs convention; optionally docs/performance/ui-baseline.md
files_to_create.purpose: Reproduction, environment, sanitized baseline and trace notes.

files_to_modify.path: None; do not change product code.

impact_and_follow_up: If no reproducible case, request more user details; do not assume mapped candidates are root causes.
steps.expected_result: Repeatable flow and baseline separating UI work from network/model latency.
verification: Another engineer can reproduce; repeated comparable measurements identify event-to-paint and expensive tasks.
steps.handoff_notes: Carry exact flow, traces, workload, build/device and baseline into profiling and implementation.

steps.title: Profile and select root cause
steps.goal: Attribute delay to specific update/render work and choose only trace-supported changes.
inputs_and_context: Inspect src/chat/services/toolActivity.ts, src/chat/hooks/useToolActivity.ts, ChatBox.tsx, AssistantMessage.tsx, StreamingMarkdown.tsx, MarkdownRenderer.tsx.
Activity/history scaling is conditional, not a proven bottleneck.
actions: Profile event dispatch, store notification, ChatBox mapping, AssistantMessage, markdown parsing/highlighting and paint.
Compare identical answer with different delta rates and sizes; profile feed/history only if reproduction includes them.
Record confirmed versus excluded causes and agree before/after target and maximum update delay. Use temporary local instrumentation only; avoid answer-content logging.

files_to_create.path: None unless existing profiling infrastructure is absent; discover convention before adding a scoped harness.

files_to_modify.path: None by default; remove temporary instrumentation.

impact_and_follow_up: Select steps 3-6 only for confirmed expensive paths; if none, investigate WebView/device contention, extensions, or backend/network instead.
steps.expected_result: Ranked trace-supported causes and concrete success metrics.
verification: Each proposed change maps to a measured hot path; traces distinguish render/paint from remote wait.
steps.handoff_notes: Provide trace timings and selected targets. Record conditional areas ruled out.

steps.title: Reduce repeated streaming-answer work
steps.goal: Reduce redundant full-text scanning or notifications when profiling confirms cost, without losing text or immediacy.
inputs_and_context: StreamingMarkdown.tsx scans split content to build chunks; useToolActivity.ts stores/notifies full live answer; toolActivity.ts produces events.
Preserve final text, event ordering, cancellation, reset and chat-switch semantics.
actions: Inspect current implementations, contracts, all producers/subscribers and tests.

Use traces to choose incremental stable-prefix chunk reuse, safe coalescing of intermediate notifications, or both; always reliably flush final text/state and cancel scheduled work on reset/abort/unmount.
Test accumulation, final flush, empty/reset, replaced/shortened text, multiple chats and cancellation; compare final result to current behavior.

files_to_create.path: Discover test convention; optionally colocated StreamingMarkdown/useToolActivity tests.
files_to_create.purpose: Streaming equivalence, flush and reset regressions.

files_to_modify.purpose: Synchronize producer contract only if event cadence/payload changes.

impact_and_follow_up: Search all producers/subscribers if contract changes; check visible cadence, final answer, abort/reset and other chats.
steps.expected_result: Less measured repeated live-answer work, identical complete final content.
verification: Focused tests pass; same long-stream profile improves without exceeding approved visible delay; short/settled answers remain correct.
steps.handoff_notes: Document cache/cadence rules and before/after timing for markdown and final validation.

steps.title: Bound markdown/highlighting cost
steps.goal: Reduce profiled markdown or code highlighting work while retaining approved rendering.
inputs_and_context: MarkdownRenderer.tsx uses ReactMarkdown/remarkGfm/rehypeHighlight auto-detection; AssistantMessage.tsx selects streaming versus settled renderer. Existing memoization/chunking already mitigate work.
actions: Trace parsing, language detection, code-block size and streaming/settled cost.
Choose smallest evidenced option (e.g. defer highlighting until settled, constrain auto-detection for oversized blocks, reuse stable chunks); obtain approval for visible tradeoffs.
Test GFM, fenced and untagged code, inline code, incomplete streaming fences, links, long/code-heavy responses; profile short and long cases.

files_to_create.path: Discover markdown test convention; add colocated fixtures/tests only if coverage is missing.

files_to_modify.purpose: Only alter renderer handoff if profiling requires.

impact_and_follow_up: Affects all assistant messages, including saved history; check code content, GFM, styling and final settle.
steps.expected_result: Lower measured parse/highlight cost without content loss or unapproved rendering changes.
verification: Fixtures pass; profiler confirms relevant improvement and no material short-response regression.
steps.handoff_notes: Record changed rendering behavior/tradeoffs and edge cases for final regression.

steps.title: Optimize workflow mapping if measured
steps.goal: Avoid redundant message scans only if ChatBox mapping is shown to be costly.
inputs_and_context: ChatBox.tsx buildWorkflowMessageMapping repeatedly scans/filters messages and derives chronology; mapping must remain correct across turns.
actions: Inspect callsites, dependencies and profile whether mapping reruns on live answer/activity updates.
If material, isolate pure mapping or build/reuse an index with correct dependencies; avoid stale mutable caches.
Test multi-turn, timestamp ties, missing workflow records, retries/edits, chat switch and unrelated live updates; profile long history.

files_to_create.path: If needed, discover convention for colocated mapping module/test; do not invent path without checking.

impact_and_follow_up: Verify workflow panel associations, retries/edits and chat switch; if not measured, make no code change.
steps.expected_result: Same workflow/message associations with fewer measured scans or cheaper executions.
verification: Mapping tests and profiler comparison pass; explicitly record not-needed if unconfirmed.
steps.handoff_notes: Document memo/index invalidation rules or explain why this conditional step was skipped.

steps.title: Handle large feed/history costs conditionally
steps.goal: Address feed/history scaling only when profile demonstrates material cost.
inputs_and_context: ToolActivityFeed.tsx renders all entries and may stringify args; useChatHistory.ts derives recent chats and saves chats when state changes. These are conditional findings; preserve row memoization and durable writes.
actions: Inspect large-feed traces and storage serialization/write timing.
If feed dominates, consider lazy args formatting, accessible collapse/limits, or virtualization; test ordering, keyboard/accessibility and scroll.
If history persistence dominates, consider safe debounce/index only after understanding flush/close/recovery guarantees; test reload and durable final writes.
If neither is material, make no edits and document ruled-out candidates.

files_to_create.path: Only tests at existing discovered feed/history conventions if a conditional change is justified.

files_to_modify.purpose: Only if feed rendering is measured.
Only if activity update cost is measured.
Only if derivation or persistence cost is measured.

impact_and_follow_up: Feed changes affect visibility/accessibility/scroll; persistence changes affect durability and close/reload. Leave unselected branch untouched.
steps.expected_result: Only measured large-data bottlenecks improved, with no hidden accessibility or durability regressions.
verification: Before/after large-data profile improves; relevant accessibility or persistence tests pass, or conditional causes documented as excluded.
steps.handoff_notes: Pass selected branch and obligations forward; state explicitly if no changes were justified.

steps.title: Regression and production performance validation
steps.goal: Verify the confirmed symptom improves and core UI behavior remains correct.
inputs_and_context: package.json scripts: npm test, npm run build. vitest.config.ts is node-only, includes src/**/*.test.ts; it cannot prove frame latency.
Use step 1 workload and step 2 agreed success targets.
actions: Run npm test and npm run build from repository root; fix and rerun failures.
Repeat exact production WebView scenario under equivalent conditions; compare event-to-paint, long tasks, commits and memory against baseline.
Check short/long streams, GFM/code, final flush, interruption/cancel, chat switch, activity feed, scroll and relevant main/avatar window behavior.
Remove unapproved diagnostic instrumentation and document before/after measures, root cause and residual risks at baseline-doc path.

files_to_create.path: Performance results path selected in step 1 if no baseline note exists.

files_to_modify.path: Only changed implementation/tests and selected performance note.
files_to_modify.purpose: Validated change set; no unrelated cleanup.

impact_and_follow_up: A failed metric or correctness regression returns to its corresponding step; compilation alone is not acceptance.
steps.expected_result: Built, tested, production-profile-verified improvement with no critical regressions.
verification: npm test and npm run build pass; equivalent production run meets agreed target; streamed content, cancellation, mapping, activity and UI behavior pass.
steps.handoff_notes: Deliver confirmed cause, files, test commands, before/after metrics, residual risks, and ruled-out conditional work.

overall_acceptance_criteria: Root causes are reproducible and trace-supported; unconfirmed candidates are not changed by default.
The original scenario improves against an agreed production baseline and latency target.
Final answer text, event order, cancellation/reset, markdown, workflow associations and persistence/accessibility semantics remain correct.
npm test, npm run build and actual browser/Tauri performance checks pass; tests/build alone do not establish responsiveness.
This request produces the plan only, not performance fixes.
risks_and_blockers: Exact reproducer/baseline and latency target are unknown until step 1 and stakeholder agreement.
Coalescing can make updates less immediate; incremental markdown caches can invalidate incorrectly during partial fences or reset.
Node-only Vitest does not measure UI frame timing; choose available WebView profiling method or add scoped harness if necessary.
Impact Mapper is source mapping, not a runtime profile; some candidates are explicitly conditional.
